questions.title: What is CSS ? What are the different ways to implement CSS in HTML ?

content.text: CSS(Cascading Style Sheets) is a stylesheet language used to control the presentation of web pages.
Different ways to implement CSS in HTML
Apply style directly to the individual HTML element using style attribute
Internal stylesheet can be implemented by adding <style> element in the <head> section of the HTML.
In external stylesheet, a separate CSS file is created with .css extension and it is linked to the HTML file using <link> tag.
- @import rule is used to include external CSS file to the main css file - Less commonly used due to potential performance issue.

questions.title: What are CSS Rules ?

content.text: A CSS rule is a set of instructions used to define how styles to be applied to selected HTML elements.
It consists of two main parts:
: Specifies which HTML element(s) the rule will apply to
: Contains one or more declarations (property-value pairs) that determine the style of the selected element(s).

questions.title: What are mixins in CSS ?

content.text: A mixin is a block of CSS declarations that can be reused throughout your stylesheets.
They enable you to encapsulate a set of styles that can be applied to different selectors, reducing redundancy and making it easier to manage styles across a project.
Mixins allow you to avoid repetitive code by defining a set of CSS properties and reusing them wherever needed, improving maintainability and reducing redundancy.
: You can define a mixin once and include it in multiple places, promoting the reuse of common styles.
: Mixins can accept parameters (like variables) to make the code even more dynamic and customizable.
: Mixins help keep your CSS codebase modular, making it easier to maintain.
